title: Room GST
items: Room up to ₹7,500 a night: 5% GST.
No input credit at 5%. Above ₹7,500 a night: 18%, with input credit.
Even for a guest from another state: the hotel's state is the place of supply, so no IGST on the room.
Discount on the bill? Take it off first.
A discount shown on the bill comes off before GST is worked out.
Every bill with its tax split, ready to export for your CA.
footer: Rizstay puts room + restaurant on one bill and works out CGST + SGST on it. GST register exports to Excel.
